name: ACA 517 发动机失效 颠簸 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: Your call sign is ACA 517, you are maintaining 10,100 meters, approaching DAPRO, squawking 3215, contact Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 ACA 517，正保持 10,100 米，接近 DAPRO，应答机 3215，联系武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 517, maintaining 1100 meters, approaching DAPRO, squawking 3215.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 517，正保持 1100 米，接近 DAPRO，应答机 3215。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 517, Wuhan Control, radar identified, omit position reports.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 517，武汉管制，雷达识别，省略位置报告。

cards.audioText: There is moderate turbulence at 10,100 meters, Ask Wuhan Control if there is any turbulence reported at 10,700 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 10,100 米有中度颠簸，询问武汉管制 10,700 米是否有颠簸报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 517, there is moderate turbulence at 1100 meters, is there any turbulence reported at 1700 meters?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 517，1100 米有中度颠簸，1700 米是否有颠簸报告？

cards.audioText:
ACA 517, there is no turbulence report at 10,700 meters.
ask to climb to 10,700 meters due moderate turbulence.
cards.audioTextZh:
ACA 517，10,700 米没有颠簸报告。
因中度颠簸请求爬升至 10,700 米。
cards.referenceText: request climb to 1700 meters due moderate turbulence, ACA 517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 因中度颠簸请求爬升至 1700 米，ACA 517。

cards.audioText: ACA 517, climb to reach 10700 meters within 2 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 517，在 2 分钟内爬升到达 10700 米。
cards.referenceText: climb to reach 1700 within two minutes, ACA 517.

cards.audioText: when you are at 10,700 meters, your left engine failed, make an urgency call and request turn right and descend to 6,300 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 当你位于 10,700 米时，左发失效，发出紧急呼叫并请求右转和下降至 6,300 米。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Control, ACA 517, our left engine failed, request turn right and descend to 6003 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，武汉管制，ACA 517，我们的左发失效，请求右转并下降至 6003 米。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 517, turn right heading 200, descend and maintain 6300 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 517，右转航向 200，下降并保持 6300 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 200, descend and maintain 6300 meters, ACA 517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 200，下降并保持 6300 米，ACA 517。

cards.audioText: B: Advise Wuhan Control you want to divert to Wuhan and track direct to WHA and descend to lower levels.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 通知 武汉管制 你想改航 Wuhan，直飞 WHA 并下降到较低高度。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 517, request divert to Wuhan and track direct to WHA and descend to lower levels.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 517，请求改航 Wuhan，直飞 WHA，并下降到较低高度。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 517, turn left, direct to WHA, descend and maintain 2100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 517，左转，直飞 WHA，下降并保持 2100 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn left, direct to WHA, descend and maintain 2100 meters, ACA 517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转，直飞 WHA，下降并保持 2100 米，ACA 517。

cards.audioText:
ACA 517, expect radar vector for VOR/DME approach 36 right.
The weather is deteriorating and below landing minimum, ask for ILS approach 36 Left.
cards.audioTextZh:
ACA 517，预计雷达引导 VOR/DME 进近 Runway 36R。
天气正在恶化并低于着陆最低标准，请求 ILS 进近 Runway 36L。
cards.referenceText: expect radar vector for VOR, DME approach Runway 36R, request ILS approach Runway 36L due deteriorating weather and below landing minima, ACA 517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 预计雷达引导 VOR、DME 进近 Runway 36R，因天气恶化并低于着陆最低标准，请求 ILS 进近 Runway 36L，ACA 517。

cards.audioText: ACA 517, Runway 36L is not available, runway in use 36 right.
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 517，Runway 36L 不可用，当前使用 Runway 36R。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 517, you are number 1 to land, there are no speed restrictions in Wuhan terminal area.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 517，你是第 1 架着陆，Wuhan 终端区无速度限制。

cards.audioText: you executed a missed approach procedure and try to land on Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 你已执行复飞程序，并尝试在 Runway 36R 落地。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA 517, going around, we will try to land on Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA 517，正在复飞，我们将尝试在 Runway 36R 落地。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 517, climb to 1200 meters, follow the standard missed approach procedure.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 517，爬升到 1200 米，执行标准复飞程序。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 1200 meters, follow the standard missed approach procedure, ACA 517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升到 1200 米，执行标准复飞程序，ACA 517。

cards.audioText: ACA 517, maintain 1,200 meters, expect radar vector ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 517，保持 1,200 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: maintain 1200 meters, expect radar vector ILS approach Runway 36R, ACA 517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 1200 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，ACA 517。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 517, runway covered with patches of water, braking action medium.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 517，跑道有片状积水，刹车效应中等。
cards.referenceText: runway covered with patches of water, breaking action medium, ACA 517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道有片状积水，刹车效应中等，ACA 517。
